svg.font-family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: Material Editor texture slots with sampling (dark theme)
svg.desc: The Textures section of the Material Editor. Each assigned slot has a quiet disclosure summarizing its non-default sampling. Base color is expanded with UV set, scale, offset, rotation, wrap U and V, and the three filters. Normal Scale and Occlusion move into the section, with the occlusion mode beside its value. Annotations on the right give the reason for each decision.
